title: Ensure orgos/agile/__init__.py exports hi
body:
Modify `orgos/agile/__init__.py` to include:
```python
from .hi import hi
```
This makes the function accessible via `orgos.agile.hi` without submodule import.

**Done when:** `from orgos.agile import hi; hi('there')` works without explicitly importing `hi.py`.

votes.justification: This is a trivial one-line import addition with no logic changes, tests needed, or design decisions. The only risk is a typo, which is negligible.

This is a one-line import addition with no logic changes, so testing is limited to verifying the import works via a quick Python invocation. Risk is minimal — the only potential issue is a missing hi module or circular import, which would be caught instantly.
This is a trivial one-line change to __init__.py with no security implications; no secrets or risky patterns are introduced. Effort is under 30 minutes, mainly to verify the import works.
